Carrier checks and some practical advice
The desk is glad to help at first light

Travelers should bring pets to Aurelia Skyways prepared, calm, and ready for a smooth check-in.
Pet travel made simple

Please keep carriers secure, label your animal clearly, and have health papers close at hand. Our staff gives each animal patient attention and expects prompt, respectful communication from every traveler. If you need help with a crate, a comfort break, or a quick review of your papers, please ask early so we can keep things moving.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we also guide travelers through the local pet spaces and lounge routines. <<FACT F018>> The team will explain what to expect at the gate area and help you plan the next steps without stress. <<FACT F002>> If you are flying with more than one pet, let us know in advance so we can help you organize the visit smoothly. <<FACT F007>>

Aurelia Skyways wants every animal to travel with care, and we are glad to support that from check-in to boarding. Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly help and a clear path forward.
